title: The Last Hand

murder.device: the cuckoo clock was torn from the wall

intro.t: He died in the Card Room at 22:00, when the cuckoo clock was torn from the wall. Whoever was in that room at 22:00 is the killer.

intro.h: Four people were snowed in at the lodge.
intro.t: Astrid the ski guide, Birger the sauna keeper, Conrad the bookkeeper and Dagny the barmaid. After the row over the accounts nobody would share a room. Four people, four rooms: every room was taken at every hour.

Between chimes there is only time to walk through one door, or to stay put. The lodge is built in a ring, so every room has two doors. Rebuild the night hour by hour, and find out who was in the Card Room at 22:00.

reasons.occupied: After the quarrel, nobody would share a room.
reasons.far: There is only time for one door per chime.

clues.text: Dagny was polishing glasses in the Bar at 21:00.
clues.hint: Tap Dagny, then tap the Bar.

clues.text: He never set foot in the Ski Room or the Card Room.
clues.hint: Nothing to place yet. Which rooms are left for Birger?

clues.lead: The sauna stones were still hot.
clues.text: At 23:00 Birger was in the Sauna, ladling water on the stones.
clues.hint: Switch to 23:00 and place Birger. Then think back: where could he have been at 21:00?

clues.lead: Two trails of wet footprints cross in a doorway.
clues.text: Between 21:00 and 22:00, Astrid and Conrad swapped rooms.
clues.hint: They traded places through one door. Which two rooms were still free at 21:00?

clues.lead: A tray of drinks was set down in a hurry.
clues.text: Between 22:00 and 23:00, Conrad and Dagny swapped rooms.
clues.hint: Conrad and Dagny traded through one door. Which doors join the rooms they could have been in?

ending: 21:00 · Astrid plays cards with Mr. Holm. Conrad waxes skis, Dagny minds the Bar, and Birger stokes the sauna.
Astrid leaves the table for the Ski Room. Conrad passes her in the doorway.
22:00 · “You have been cooking the books.” The cuckoo clock is torn from the wall. Mr. Holm is dead, and Conrad is alone with him.
Conrad slips into the Bar as Dagny carries a tray of drinks into the Card Room.
23:00 · Dagny drops the tray and screams.
closing: Conrad was alone with Mr. Holm when the clock fell.
